exactIssue: A Codex executor derived 76 non-validation questionnaire records by arithmetic and silently upgraded that artifact observation into the scientific acceptance rule that a complete profile requires 76 items. No owner or reasoning-chat directive selected that denominator, and production scoring actually exposes 27 frozen rules spanning 23 unique question IDs. The unauthorized criterion then entered owner-facing prose and independent-review premises as if it were established authority.

relevantRule.section: Machine-checkable dual alignment and typed completion
relevantRule.excerpt: Every material requirement must be mapped, explicitly amended/removed by the owner, or escalated.

observedOrHypotheticalFailure: Authentic owner-source receipts and dual alignment did not prevent an executor-added numeric specificity from becoming a scientific criterion. Worker-to-contract can remain GREEN after the inference is copied into the contract, synthetic tests can validate the mechanics without validating production cardinality, and later reviewers can inherit the producer-supplied number rather than reproduce it. This can falsely authorize scientific readiness or release while the actual acceptance rule remains unresolved.

evidenceRefs.finding: 81 total and 76 non-validation are question-bank facts; 23 unique mapped IDs is a production scoring fact; neither number is an authorized scientific completeness criterion.

evidenceRefs.observation: The browser runtime returned no available browser instances, so no signed-in Pro meta-review verdict was obtained.

proposedChange: UNVERIFIED SUBAGENT PROPOSAL: Add claim-level provenance with explicit authority and claim-kind typing; treat every executor-added denominator, threshold, sample size, validation phase, or evidence-sufficiency rule as unauthorized unless enumerated in a current owner or reasoning-chat directive; add reconciliation states UNAUTHORIZED_ADDITION, INFERRED_NUMERIC_SCOPE, and DERIVATION_UNVERIFIED; rerun objective reconciliation whenever a load-bearing numeric or scientific criterion changes; require production-artifact cardinality evidence and independent reproduction; prevent synthetic fixtures from satisfying production-cardinality evidence; and reject definitive owner-facing rendering of unregistered claims. A verified Extra High reasoning chat must independently diagnose and accept, revise, or reject this proposal before it can enter the shared Pro lane.
proRevisedChange: Use scoped conjunctive required authorizations rather than an authority rank; require an append-only PROMOTED transition and a new qualifying authority source for fact-to-policy use; bind reproduction to the exact subject while prohibiting reproduction from promoting authority; and fail owner-facing definitive rendering closed for unregistered, stale, advisory, or descriptive-only claims. Human Design completeness requires OWNER_EXPLICIT for 23, 76, or any third denominator.
